objective: Implement, execute, train, and compare a single-neuron binary classifier using synthetic data and sigmoid/ReLU activation functions.

functions.name: process_employee_data
functions.purpose: Calculate employee pay, overtime, department bonus, tax, net pay, department code, and payment status.

functions.name: single_neuron
functions.purpose: Calculate a weighted linear sum and apply sigmoid or ReLU activation.

supported_activations.name: relu
supported_activations.formula: linear_output when linear_output >= 0, otherwise negative_slope * linear_output

functions.name: binary_classifier
functions.purpose: Apply a trained or supplied neuron to every row of a dataset.

functions.name: generate_synthetic_dataset
functions.purpose: Generate reproducible random features and binary labels.
functions.label_rule: label = 1 when features @ weights + bias >= 0, otherwise label = 0

functions.name: calculate_weights
functions.purpose: Train a single neuron using mean-squared-error gradient descent.

initialization.weight_distribution: Normal with mean 0.0 and standard deviation 0.01

validation: At least one row and one feature

activation_training_results.analysis: Best fit for this run; lower final MSE than ReLU. Weight signs retain the positive/negative pattern of the source weights [2.0, -1.0].
Weight signs match the source pattern, but the different activation scale and shape produced a higher final MSE than sigmoid.

analysis_conclusion.interpretation: Sigmoid achieved the lower mean-squared error under the same dataset, learning rate, epoch count, and weight initialization. The weight magnitudes should not be compared directly across activations because sigmoid and ReLU map linear outputs differently.

debugging_changes: Validated equal neuron input and weight lengths.
Validated sigmoid temperature and ReLU negative slope.
Validated dataset dimensions and binary labels.
Validated sample count, feature count, bias, noise, and weight shape.
Validated positive learning rate and positive epoch count.
Added divergence detection for non-finite weights or bias.
Added binary-classifier accuracy reporting for both activations.
Added detailed module, function, and entry-point headers/comments.
